faq.q: What is the difference between in-market and out-of-market?
faq.a: In-market means you live in the area a team's local broadcaster covers. Those local games are on that broadcaster and are blacked out on League Pass. Out-of-market means you live anywhere else, so the local broadcast is not available to you but League Pass is.
Each service carries the date its price was last checked. Anything without a confirmed price shows as not confirmed instead of a number.
